notes.title: New Release! Get ZHive for $1.79 (-40%)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone

We have launched another wallet friendly game...Zhive!

Zhive is a small and simple strategy game where you command the undead on the map by selecting the areas where you want them to spawn and then direct them to a target area. But be careful, think strategically. The soldiers are well equipped and can decimate your minions with ease. Don't let them roam around, they could restock and find the survivor!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/110f5f3f7069ae9cbfabe596cf19ef9930b577e5.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119530/ZHIVE/

notes.title: New Release! Get ORC RAID for $3.50 [30% launch discount]
notes.content:
Hello Everyone.

We have released a new game! Orc Raid is a first person shooter where you fight tons enemies coming at you. It features a small story mode and the classic survival mode to rank via online leaderboards. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061160/Orc_Raid/

While this time, the game sports a more fantasy like world, It still contains our signature content..... :)

It has..... explosions!

It has..... flying bodyparts!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/61236771fd050adb7ed10bdb9f6baf6bd972b973.gif[/img]

It has.... blood splashing everywhere!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/1f4a1404ae5e619b318cb7b7f60e51df5edc5e3c.gif[/img]

Did I mention it has flying bodyparts?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/94e75d5eceaa76fac2dfd5dc00c02fd2b16c7caa.gif[/img]

We hope you can support us with your purchase so we can keep raising the quality bar so one day, we can produce a game that will forever be remembered. 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Game! "Dragon Chase" is now available! [30% Off]
notes.content:
Hello Everyone

We present you another wallet friendly game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/12778fd3b1a12f568afb01ab807460b43d6f7ab3.gif[/img]

Dragon chase is a small game hybrid between a platformer and a runner where you take the control of a knight being chased by a Dragon. Avoid being ripped by the Dragon, dodge traps and fend off enemies on a randomized environment.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/2a93ff5bfa7254f187d80e6a3ddb0db69642cdc1.gif[/img]

Dragon Chase is available for just 2 dollars and currently has a launch discount of 30%. We recommend you to get Dragon Chase if you would like to enjoy a quick challenge. We hope you can support us with your purchase.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1011240/Dragon_Chase/

Thanks and have fun :)

notes.title: Happy Autumn Sale! and check out a new game!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We wish you a happy autumn sale and that you buy so many games that you won't be able to finish them this lifetime :)

In other news, we have released another wallet friendly game! [b]Time Splatter is available for $0.60[/b]..... But what is a Time Splatter? How do you eat it? [gif below]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/674882d078679411cffcc2fc5a98ec15d7ef96f2.gif[/img]

Time splatter is a small episodic rail shooter game where our protagonist, after touching an ancient monolith, is transported to the times where the black plague transformed people into zombie like creatures and knights protected the land. [Another gif below....]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/80c380c8f250ef2aa122d59203415ba09b79edf5.gif[/img]

At launch, only chapter 1 will be available, but we plan to release two more chapters... for free. If the game does well, there are concepts for another three, but lets not get ahead hehe. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/949530/Time_Splatter/

We hope you can support us with your purchase and keep helping us making games. We are hoping to step up the level of our games and bring you better and larger experiences early next year. But you, mighty players are the ones that will make this possible with your purchases and reviews. 

Check out our other games.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/904130/Defense_Abominations/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/846010/Visceral_Cubes/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/649450/Deadly_Escape/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/618610/Endless_Horde/

As always thanks for playing!

PD. We just sorted a couple problems we had that made development difficult. Expect to see content updates for several games soon.

notes.title: Check out Visceral Cubes! [40% OFF]
notes.content:
Hello Everyone

We have released another small horror game, Visceral Cubes is a game where you survive by evading your enemies. You can stealth your way past them or run for your life hoping that they don't catch up and explode in your face.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/35b75336ca88b75113fba229ce1d8ae65764fa79.gif[/img]

Just like when Deadly Escape launched, we are working on eviscerating the bugs being reported, as well as creating new free content . We were hoping to announce this game to the communities of our other games after a couple updates could perfect it, but...... we figured out it would be better idea to announce it while the launch discount is still being applied lol.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/846010/Visceral_Cubes/

Visceral Cubes is our first 3D horror game, it represents the next step into perfecting our craft towards a truly horrifying experience where we hope to make you screaming in horror, an experience we hope you'll never forget.

But one step at a time. 

As always thank you for your support!

notes.title: Deadly Escape Update #1
notes.content:
Deadly Escape v1.0.13 is now online! 

[h1]BugFixes/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]The player will not get stuck anymore after repeatedly pressing the spawn door button when the door is already open.
    [*]The generator will now activate even if you close the dialogue before it fully opens.
    [*]Fixed some undead that were not attacking the player.
    [*]Fixed some instances where "shoot barrel" was randomly appearing.
    [*]The player will not turn towards the hatches and escape(without 
        "moonwalk").
    [*]The undead coming out of the bottom left hatch will not moonwalk 
        anymore during the cutscene.
    [*]Fixed the description of the key cards and fuses.
    [*]After the game is over, the cursor will now show on the screen.
    [*]When accessed via the pause menu, the fullscreen option will now 
       reflect what the player set via the main menu.
    [*]The achievements are now online.
    [*]Fixed the collision area of some props.
    [*]Arranged several graphic layers that had an incorrect order.
    [*]The boss will not get stuck anymore in the bottom left corner.
    [*]Fixed some instances where the help and dialogues overlapped each 
       other.
    [*]Fixed a bug where the guards NPC kept shooting after the undead 
        were already dead(no pun intended).
    [*]Targeting Fixes, after shooting an exploding barrel, the target will now 
       position over the closest undead.

[/list]

[h1]In development[/h1]
[list]
[*]Chapter2
[*]Leaderboards.
[*]More bug fixes. 

[/list]
[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]
[list]
[*]We still have a lot of bugs to fix, thank you for your patience!
[*]If you liked the game, support us with your review! this way we will be able to bring you as many chapters as possible!
[*]Have you played [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/618610/Endless_Horde/]Endless Horde?[/url] check it out if you have the chance. It is a minigame but it ties to the story. Can you guess how? One of the leftover notes gives you a hint.
[*]Join our new group! Once we gather enough members we'll give away cool stuff. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/ominousgaminggroup]Join us![/url]
[/list]

And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: Deadly Escape is now available, 40% off!
notes.content:
We hope you enjoy Deadly Escape, get it now while the launch discount lasts.

At the time of release, Deadly Escape has chapter 1 available. We will add several other chapters as time goes by, starting with chapter 2. We hope to bring you several other chapters for free if the game does well enough.

The chapters won't be very long, but be careful... if you die, you will have to start the chapter all over.

Of course, what is a game without their players, please check out the game, help us dish out any bugs you may find by posting at the forums.

[h1]Incoming New Stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Chapter 2.[/b] Fight for survival against new enemies in the laboratory area!
[*][b]Enabling the achievements[/b] 
[*][b]Enabling the leaderboard[/b] 
[*][b]Several bug fixes.[/b] The boss music seems to not activate(sometimes), a random undead ignoring the player etc.
[*][b]Balancing.[/b] A couple tweaks to the game difficulty.
[/list]
[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Join our new group! Once gather enough members we'll give away cool stuff. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/ominousgaminggroup]Join us!
[*]Deadly Escape has a different programmer than Endless Horde. We'll be supporting both games from now on!
[/list]
And as always, thanks for your support!
